name: Bold Geometric Collage Pricing Cards

description.zh: 三张高饱和撞色卡片并排，每张内部叠放巨大的黑色几何形（圆、圆角方、尖角菱形），像拼贴海报一样压在文字下方。价格用超大粗体白字压住图形，顶部有半透明胶囊标签，底部是等宽字体的白色按钮。
description.en: Three saturated colour cards sit side by side, each layered with a huge black geometric shape — a circle, a rounded square, a pointed diamond — collaged behind the text like a poster. Oversized bold white pricing type overlaps the shapes, a translucent pill label sits top-left, and a monospace white button anchors the bottom.

reconstructionPrompt: Three side-by-side pricing cards on a dark page, each a rounded rectangle in a different saturated hue: electric blue-violet, bright purple, and hot pink. Inside each card a large black geometric shape is collaged behind the content — a circle, a rounded square, and a pointed diamond respectively. A translucent pill label sits top-left, an oversized bold white price headline overlaps the black shape, muted white body copy sits below, and a full-width white monospace uppercase button anchors the bottom. On hover the first card's black circle scales up and overflows the card boundary, and its button becomes a glowing grey gradient with an outline.
